# Project 20: Content Repurposing Engine

**Category:** 3. Marketing, Branding & Content
**Status:** Pending. Not started; work begins only on the explicit command `Start Project 20`.

## Brief (from the source PDF)

Converts one long video, article or podcast into multiple short-form assets.

> Original: Ek long video, article ya podcast ko multiple short-form assets mein convert karta hai.

### Core features

- Reels scripts
- Carousels
- Posts
- Newsletter snippets

| Service | Port |

| Backend / API | 8020 |
| Frontend dev server | 5120 |
